summary: Master GDS, PMS, and digital transformation in tourism. Learn to integrate Tourism Technology and Systems for operational excellence. Enroll today.
lede: Tourism technology and systems training helps travel and hospitality professionals understand the digital tools behind bookings, operations, and guest services. It covers assessing existing systems, coordinating inventory across channels, integrating reservation and property platforms, and using revenue, customer relationship, and analytics tools to support operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the digital infrastructure and operational efficiency of travel and hospitality organizations.
modules: Property Management Systems and Hospitality Tech
Central Reservation Systems and Channel Management
Revenue Management Systems and Pricing Tech
Digital Marketing and CRM in Tourism
Data Privacy and Cybersecurity in Travel
AI and Emerging Tech in Tourism
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in travel, tourism, or hospitality management. Familiarity with basic reservation processes and a general understanding of business software is required. No advanced programming knowledge is necessary, but an interest in digital workflows is essential.
